protocolMetadata.instructions: Use this server to search official Microsoft/Azure documentation, fetch full page content, and search code samples. Workflow: Use 'microsoft_docs_search' first for overview, then 'microsoft_docs_fetch' for complete page content when needed. Use 'microsoft_code_sample_search' when generating Microsoft/Azure code. Search gives breadth, fetch gives depth, code search gives examples.

tool.description:
Search official Microsoft/Azure documentation for the most relevant and trustworthy content.
Returns up to 10 high-quality content chunks with title, URL, and excerpt.

## Usage:
Always use this tool first to ground answers in official Microsoft/Azure knowledge when facing Microsoft/Azure related questions, then use microsoft_docs_fetch for complete page content when needed.

Search for code snippets in official Microsoft Learn documentation.
Returns relevant code samples with practical implementation examples for Microsoft/Azure products. Helps you use the **LATEST OFFICIAL** code snippets.

- When providing sample Microsoft/Azure related code snippets
- When generating any Microsoft/Azure related code

tool.name: microsoft_docs_fetch
tool.title: Microsoft Docs Fetch
tool.description:
Fetch complete content from a Microsoft documentation page and convert to markdown.

## When to Use:
- Search results are incomplete or truncated
- Need complete procedures, troubleshooting steps, or detailed explanations
- Found a highly relevant page in search results

## Workflow:
Use after microsoft_docs_search to get full content from high-value pages.

## URL Requirements:
Must be a valid microsoft.com domain URL.

## Returns:
Markdown with headings, code blocks, tables, and links preserved.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Microsoft Learn MCP Server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Microsoft Learn MCP Server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Microsoft Learn MCP Server MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, Microsoft Learn MCP Server scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Microsoft Learn MCP Server's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, Microsoft Learn MCP Server scores 78/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 3 of 3 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Microsoft Learn MCP Server?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Microsoft Learn MCP Server in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: How can Microsoft Learn MCP Server improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: microsoft_docs_fetch is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 67/100. No output schema is declared. Add one for structured results so clients can interpret returned fields. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
